steps.name: Differential expression: limma-voom (primary) with Wilcoxon control and DESeq2/apeglm effect sizes
caveats: State explicitly in the output that count-model p-values (DESeq2/edgeR Wald/LRT) are not used for significance calls in this cohort size, only for LFC shrinkage

steps.context: 60 cases vs 60 controls, single batch, unpaired whole-blood RNA-seq gene counts. Knowledge base flags that at n>=50/group, DESeq2/edgeR negative-binomial models can exaggerate false discovery in population cohorts (Squair et al. 2021); limma-voom is the primary grounded method, with a Wilcoxon test as the recommended control per the same literature.
steps.question: Which of the 12000 genes differ significantly between the 60 cases and 60 controls, and what is the shrunken effect size (log2 fold change) of each — i.e., which differences are both statistically significant AND large enough to matter?

grounding.reason: n=60/60 triggers R-0015 (limma-voom primary + Wilcoxon control); R-0009 requires apeglm shrinkage (via a parallel DESeq2 fit, since apeglm is a DESeq2-family shrinkage method) reported beside the unshrunk estimate; R-0037/R-0043 require the fold-change threshold to be tested inside the model, not post-hoc

acceptance_criteria: Genes pre-filtered with edgeR::filterByExpr (min.count=10, group=condition) before normalization; number of genes retained out of 12000 reported
TMM normalization (edgeR::calcNormFactors) applied; voom precision weights computed on the filtered, TMM-normalized counts
Case/control reference level set explicitly (control = reference); contrast named case_vs_control
limma-voom fixed-effects model fit (~condition) and eBayes moderated t-test run as the PRIMARY inferential test

A Wilcoxon rank-sum test per gene (on normalized log-CPM) run as a robustness control given n=60/60; overlap of limma-voom significant genes with Wilcoxon significant genes reported, and any large divergence flagged explicitly as evidence of false-positive inflation
A parallel DESeq2 fit (median-of-ratios normalization, same design) run for the sole purpose of apeglm log2FC shrinkage; DESeq2 p-values are NOT used as the significance call
apeglm-shrunk log2FoldChange computed from the DESeq2 fit and reported alongside the unshrunk limma logFC and its SE, for every tested gene

TREAT/glmTreat-style test against an explicit fold-change threshold (log2FC threshold stated, e.g. |log2FC|>=0.5, chosen and stated in the report) run in addition to the zero-null test, so 'large enough to matter' is a pre-specified test, not a post-hoc filter on the estimate
p-value histogram of the primary test inspected and its shape (uniform/anticonservative/conservative) reported before trusting BH-adjusted values

Gene table sorted by shrunken effect size within the significant set, retaining unshrunk log2FC, shrunk log2FC, lfcSE, moderated-t/Wald stat, raw p, and adjusted p as columns

steps.name: Immune cell composition estimate (whole blood context)
caveats: This is a bulk-deconvolution estimate, not measured cell counts (e.g., no CBC data in the provided metadata) — treat results as an exploratory check, not a validated cell-count comparison
steps.context: Whole blood bulk RNA-seq, 60 cases vs 60 controls. Whole-blood case/control transcriptomic differences are commonly driven by shifts in circulating leukocyte proportions (e.g., neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio) rather than uniform per-cell change; this step tests whether the DE signal in T1S2 is confounded by composition.

grounding.reason: No rule in the bulk RNA-seq knowledge base covers immune deconvolution; added because whole-blood tissue context makes compositional confounding a standard interpretive concern for case/control DE

plan.title: Whole blood case vs control DE + effect size + pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: 60 cases vs 60 controls whole-blood RNA-seq (Salmon gene counts, 12000 genes x 121 samples incl. metadata for 120). Given the large per-group n (60/60), the knowledge base flags that DESeq2/edgeR negative-binomial models exaggerate false positives on population-scale cohorts; limma-voom with precision weights is the grounded choice, backed by a Wilcoxon rank-sum control to catch any residual inflation. The plan separates 'differs' (BH-adjusted significance from limma-voom, tested against a fold-change threshold with TREAT/glmTreat) from 'differs enough to matter' (effect size: apeglm-shrunk log2FC computed from a parallel DESeq2 fit, reported beside the limma logFC, ranked and thresholded rather than picked post-hoc). QC precedes modeling to catch outliers/structure in a single unblocked batch. Enrichment runs on the full ranked gene list (moderated t-statistic) via camera and fgsea against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome (both staged locally), never on a p-value-thresholded list. A blood-composition check (immune deconvolution) is included because whole-blood case/control differences are frequently driven by shifts in leukocyte proportions rather than per-cell transcriptional change — this directly matters for interpreting which DE genes are 'real' cell-intrinsic differences vs. compositional artifacts.
